derivation.behavior: Legacy Room engine state imports once into Go without dual-write.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Android importer maps supported legacy rows into versioned Go import package then stops authoritative Room writes.

invariants: Room schema 25 is sampled into a versioned one-time import package.
The Go engine persists the committed Android authority snapshot outside Room.
Repeating identical import content is idempotent; changed Room content cannot overwrite committed Go authority.
Downloads, attempts, history, queues, schedules, recovery, captures, and variants are represented when supportable.
Live Room-to-Go projection mirrors stop after cutover and Go media selections are not dual-written.
